spec_clauses.text: Concrete slab: existing slab retained, 120 mm topping grade C25/30 where levelled. Clause 3.2 of the structural specification.
Reinforcement: deformed steel rebar, 85 kg per cubic metre of new concrete, laps 600 mm minimum. Clause 3.4.
Masonry walls: clay bricks, 50 bricks per square metre of new wall, mortar mix 1:4 cement:sand. Clause 4.1.
Floor finishes: ceramic tiles to kitchenette, 10 square metres, adhesive bed 3 mm. Clause 5.2.
Roof framing: softwood timber, grade C24, 65 linear metres of ceiling joists. Clause 6.1.
Fixtures: 6 plumbing and lighting fixtures as scheduled on sheet A-103. Clause 7.3.
